summary: Feather Wiki is a single-file JavaScript application designed for building personal knowledge bases, non-linear notebooks, and structured databases. Running entirely within your web browser, the entire codebase spans a mere 58 kilobytes. It provides a lightweight approach to maintaining interconnected notes without relying on external cloud infrastructure.
goodFor: It suits technical users who want an ultra-lightweight, portable tool for local note-taking and personal documentation without installing complex server stacks.
watchOut: The lack of recent version tags and recorded community activity means you should expect to maintain it yourself without much upstream support. Additionally, it lacks built-in multi-user synchronisation features out of the box.
deployNotes: Because it runs as a client-side JavaScript file, you typically only need a basic static web server to host it, with no separate backend database required.
